create species-specific FASTQ files, derived from each sample, using generated kNN.tsv file
```{r}
# inputs
fastq_dir <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/illumina_runs/AHG_illumina_*/genewiz_data/PEARed_FASTP_filtered_FORMATTED"
map_file  <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/illumina_runs/AHG_illumina_*/genewiz_data/kNN_taxonomy.tsv"

# output
out_dir <- "/Users/john.archer/Documents/Glasgow/anthelmogram/illumina_runs/AHG_illumina_*/genewiz_data/species_specific_FASTQ"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# load kNN table
map <- fread(map_file, header = FALSE)
colnames(map) <- c("id", "species")

# ensure character
map$id <- as.character(map$id)
map$species <- as.character(map$species)

# lookup table
id_to_species <- setNames(map$species, map$id)

# FASTQ files
fastq_files <- list.files(
  fastq_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fastq$",
  full.names = TRUE
)



# loop over each sample
for (fq_file in fastq_files) {

  sample <- sub("\\.fastq$", "", basename(fq_file))
  cat("processing sample:", sample, "\n")

  fq <- readFastq(fq_file)

  # extract clean IDs
  ids <- as.character(id(fq))
  ids <- sub("^@", "", ids)
  ids <- sub(" .*", "", ids)

  # match species
  species <- id_to_species[ids]

  # drop unmapped reads
  keep <- !is.na(species)

  fq <- fq[keep]
  species <- species[keep]

  # split indices by species
  idx <- split(seq_along(fq), species)

  # write per species FASTQ
  for (sp in names(idx)) {

    out_file <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(sample, "_", sp, ".fastq")
    )

    writeFastq(
      fq[idx[[sp]]],
      file = out_file,
      compress = FALSE
    )
  }
}

cat("species-specific fastq files generated\n")
```
